title: add_task
description: Create a new task for the authenticated user. This tool should be used when the user expresses intent to add, create, remember, or track something. Natural language examples: 'I need to buy milk', 'Remember to call the dentist', 'Add task: finish report'.

user_id.description: The authenticated user's ID (extracted from JWT token). Required for user data isolation.

title.description: The task title (1-200 characters). Should be extracted from user's natural language input.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the task. Use when user provides additional context beyond the title.

success.description: Whether the task was created successfully

message.description: User-friendly confirmation message (e.g., 'Added task: Buy groceries')

errors.description: Title is empty or exceeds 200 characters
User ID mismatch or invalid JWT token
Failed to create task in database
